about.title: ABOUT ME
about.text:
I am a Fullstack developer passionate about learning, exploring and constantly improving through every challenge. I see each mistake as an opportunity to grow, which has helped me develop a persevering, committed and solution-oriented mindset.

My focus is not limited to web applications; it also includes mobile development. I aim to create efficient solutions that optimize processes while always prioritizing an intuitive user experience and functional design.
